_source: Jack Daniels, Daniels' Running Formula (VDOT tables). All values in seconds per km. M is the marathon time from the race-equivalency table divided by 42.195 (the planner's M is the predicted marathon race pace). T is the per-km T pace. I is the 400 m I pace x 2.5. R is the 400 m I pace minus 6 s, x 2.5 (Daniels' own rule, the one the planner uses). E is the published E/L range [fast, slow]; Daniels gives E as a range, so the test checks that the planner's E lies inside it.
